messages:
maria_sales: Hi team — Acme POC update. They're asking to increase burst capacity on the dedicated POC pool (pool id: p-ded-82) for demo week. Current reservation is 4 gpus, request is to allow bursts up to 12 for the demo window (4hrs). Need: (1) quick cost delta for the burst; (2) scoped ephemeral API keys for their devs; (3) timeline to provision. Demo is Mon 03/30 14:00-18:00 PDT. Can we turn around by EOD tomorrow? :pray:

josh_eng: Got it. A few quick Qs — expected peak RPS and avg token length? which model are they running? also region? Need to verify autoscale config on p-ded-82 before proposing changes.

maria_sales: Model: redwood-7b-compat, region: us-west2. Expected peak ~120 RPS, median seq ~1024 tokens during demo traces. It's a short burst (4 hrs) but they may sustain near peak for ~45-60 mins.

anika_sre: We can do a temporary autoscale override for the POC. Proposal: min_instances=2 (keep baseline), max_instances=12, burst_enabled=true, burst_mode=credit, burst_credits=1500, scale_window=120s. Also enable prefix KV caching for sessions to reduce token cost during steady periods.

joni: (typo)

josh_eng: Cost back-of-envelope: if each instance is an rtx-a10 equivalent and costs ~ $2.8/hr (on our bill), extra 8 instances * 4 hrs * $2.8 ~= $90 plus overhead and storage — round to $150 buffer. But burst credits and short-lived reserved capacity ticks may add managed markup; recommend quoting $250 for safety to customer. If they want committed monthly capacity that's separate.

toni_soleng: Security note: Acme asked for ephemeral keys. We should create scoped API keys limited to model:generate and embeddings:create, with dataset write disabled. Also set expire_at to 2026-04-01T00:00:00Z and tag keys with acme-poc. Confirm they don't need VPC. If they do, that's a separate Private/VPC onboarding — longer lead time.

anika_sre: I'll raise infra ticket INF-3217 to (a) create poc-tempo pool override for p-ded-82, (b) attach burst config, (c) provision scoped API keys and set TTL, (d) enable extra logging for the demo. Assigning to @josh_eng for rollout and cost estimate. Will require finance approval for ad-hoc burst.

josh_eng: Copy. Patch command I'll run (example):

```
PATCH /v1/dedicated/pools/p-ded-82/autoscale
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "min_instances": 2,
  "max_instances": 12,
  "burst_enabled": true,
  "burst_mode": "credit",
  "burst_credits": 1500,
  "scale_window_seconds": 120
}
```

I'll also add a rollback hook to revert to max=4 after 6 hours post-demo.

maria_sales: Thanks. Please include cost line item for sales quote and send scoped keys via secure DM to me (don't post in channel). Also need PO and billing contact — Acme will route via their procurement, expect a PO # before invoice.

anika_sre: Ticket INF-3217 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3217 — assigned to josh_eng. I've set finance-approval required flag. @finance-ops please review estimate and approve one-time burst (est $250).

deploy-bot: Pool update deployed: p-ded-82 autoscale={min:2, max:12, burst:enabled, credits:1500} by josh_eng at 1764532300

josh_eng: Deployed and smoke-tested. Latency on sample trace stayed within SLO at peak. Rollback hook scheduled at 1764536000 (6 hours after demo window end). Will DM the scoped keys to @maria_sales once finance signs off.

anika_sre: I'll also set a monitoring alert to watch token spend and invoke auto-fallback to hosted smaller model if spend or latency goes off rails. Planning to mark this POC override as timeboxed — auto-revert in infra.

maria_sales: Perfect — appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup: I'll coordinate PO and ping finance.
